changeinfo.changes:
• Seasoned Veteran can now be unlocked across multiple sittings.
  • Fixed a crash that occurred when playing the campaign in German.
  • Stopped ‘Dark’ matches appearing as ‘Light’ matches in the menus.
  • Fixed a number of issues that would change the outcome of previous turns.
  • Improved the speed of the UI.
  • Fixed various crashes.
  • Additional minor bug fixes.

• Fix for Campaign medals not updating when replaying missions.
  • Fix a number of instances where multiplayer games could desynchronise.
  • Fix a number of crashes, including deleting waypoints and multiplayer connections.
  • Fix a number of animation issues with spectre units.
  • Enabled Match Timeout of two weeks on multiplayer matches.
